plugins.name: legal-builder-hub
plugins.description: Finds, evaluates, and installs community legal skills — with a security review gate before anything lands in your environment.

skills.name: auto-updater
skills.description: Check installed community skills for updates. Shows a diff and requires explicit approval before applying. Use when the user says "check for updates", "update my skills", "anything new for my installed skills", or when invoked from the registry-sync agent.
headings: Step 2.5: Re-scan the new version (GlassWorm gate)
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 检查已安装社区技能更新，展示差异并在明确批准后应用，支持用户更新查询或registry-sync调用。

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Practice-profile interview that recommends and installs a starter pack of community legal skills. This IS the cold start for the whole ecosystem — it asks what kind of lawyer you are and recommends what to install first. Use on fresh install, when the user says "get me started" or "what should I install", or to re-run the integration-availability check after adding or removing an MCP connector.
headings: Check for the shared company profile
After the user picks quick or full
Quick start or full setup — branching
Part 0: Who's using this, and what's connected
skills.description_zh: 访谈法律执业画像并推荐安装社区法律技能初始包，支持首次安装、起步选择及MCP增删后的集成可用性复查。

skills.name: customize
skills.description: Guided customization of your Legal Builder Hub profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust practice profile, installed starter pack, watched registries, update preferences, or QA strictness. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "add a registry", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
skills.description_zh: 单项调整Legal Builder Hub执业画像、已装初始包、关注注册库、更新偏好和QA严格度，无需重做入门访谈。

skills.name: disable
skills.description: Disable a community skill installed through the hub without removing its files. Use when the user wants to temporarily quiet a community skill ("disable [skill]"), stop its hooks from firing while keeping its config, or re-enable a previously disabled skill.
skills.description_zh: 暂时禁用通过Hub安装的社区技能及挂钩，保留文件配置，并支持重新启用。

skills.name: registry-browser
skills.description: Search watched registries for community legal skills, showing matches with descriptions and offering to show the full SKILL.md before install. Use when the user says "browse", "search skills", "find a skill for", "what's out there for", or wants to add a new registry to the watchlist.
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 搜索关注注册库中的社区法律技能，展示说明并可在安装前查看完整SKILL.md，支持新增注册库关注。

skills.name: related-skills-surfacer
skills.description: Suggest community skills based on recent activity in other plugins. Checks whether the community has built something relevant to a task and mentions it once, non-intrusively. Use when the user says "is there a community skill for this", "what else is out there", or asks for skill recommendations; also runs passively as part of other plugins' workflows.
headings: Close with the next-steps decision tree
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 依据其他插件近期活动寻找相关社区技能，低干扰地提示一次，支持推荐查询或作为工作流中的被动步骤。

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install a community skill from a watched registry. Reads the allowlist first, fetches, shows the RAW SKILL.md (not just a summary), runs structural trust checks, runs skills-qa, and only writes files after explicit user approval. Use when the user says "install [skill]", picks install from browse, or provides a direct skill URL.
headings: A note on the limits of AI-mediated trust
Step 1: Read the allowlist (before fetching anything)
Step 6: Show everything and get explicit approval
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 从关注注册库安装社区技能，先查允许名单、获取并展示原始SKILL.md、做结构信任检查和skills-qa，仅在用户明确批准后写文件。

skills.name: skill-manager
skills.description: Reference: detailed uninstall, disable, and re-enable workflows for community skills installed via the legal builder hub. Safe by default — refuses to touch first-party plugin skills, confirms before removing files, and logs every action. Loaded by the /legal-builder-hub:uninstall and /legal-builder-hub:disable skills.
headings: What this skill may act on
Step 1: Verify the skill is community-installed
skills.description_zh: 提供Hub社区技能卸载、禁用和重启的详细流程，不修改第一方插件技能，删除前确认并记录操作。

skills.name: skills-qa
skills.description: Evaluate a skill against the Legal Skill Design Framework — thirteen design parameters (including trust-surface, freshness, schema validation, and conflict detection), three legal failure modes, and a three-band verdict (Ready / Some Concern / Material Concerns). Use when deciding whether to trust a community skill before installing it, before deploying a first-party skill to your team, or whenever the user asks "should I trust this?" or "is this skill well-designed?". Runs automatically as part of /legal-builder-hub:skill-installer.
headings: Step 3: Evaluate the thirteen design parameters
skills.description_zh: 按Legal Skill Design Framework的13项设计参数、3类法律失败模式及三档结论评估技能，涵盖信任面、时效、模式验证和冲突，支持安装或团队部署前审查。

skills.name: uninstall
skills.description: Uninstall a community skill that was installed via the hub. Confirms before deleting files, refuses to touch first-party plugin skills, and logs every action. Use when the user wants to fully remove a community skill ("uninstall [skill]", "remove this skill") rather than just disable it.
skills.description_zh: 卸载经Hub安装的社区技能，删除文件前确认、不触及第一方插件并记录每项操作，适用于彻底移除而非临时禁用。
